<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“We have,” Yala said, firmly taking the reins of the conversation back from Kerian.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|— ''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Yala the High Mason Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Yala, also known as the High [[Mason]] or [[High Councilor]] Yala, is a prominent leader within the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] and serves as one of the three [[Architects]] on the High [[Council]]. As a leader of the [[Masons]]—an order that trains professionals to act as insiders for the [[Consultants]]—she holds significant [[Authority|authority]] and is known for her extensive combat experience. Her reputation includes legendary exploits, such as single-handedly halting a rebellion by infiltrating enemy lines and neutralizing a [[Champion]]. Physically, she is described as a tall, weathered woman with tanned, wrinkled skin and long hair that is a mix of blond and gray, often worn in a braid or tight tail. Yala is characterized by her stern, haughty, and dignified demeanor. She is fiercely protective of the [[Guild]]'s interests and [[Authority|authority]], often clashing with others over matters of loyalty, rank, and protocol. She has historically been an adversary to [[Shera]], having advocated for her imprisonment or execution, though her stance shifted toward supporting [[Shera]]'s new identity as the [[Mistress of the Mists]]. Despite her age, she remains physically capable and limber in combat. In the wake of the Emperor's death, Yala has focused on ensuring the prosperity and survival of the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] amidst political instability and the rise of the [[Regents]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Yala is a blond woman with gray-yellow hair and a weather-beaten face. She wears black clothing that reaches up to her neck, though she does not wear a shroud over her face.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Councilor and High [[Mason]], Yala is known to speak sourly and has been described as having potentially selfish motivations. She is a combat-experienced leader who expresses happiness regarding [[Shera]]'s failures and has ordered the detention and shooting of others. While she views certain duties as religious, she habitually underestimates [[Gardeners]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|High Council Architect}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Mentioned by [[Ayana]], Yala is a blond Councilor who assigned [[Shera]] a mission and joined a conversation with both [[Shera]] and [[Kerian]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c2">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 26</ref> As a combat-experienced [[Mason]] in the [[Guild]]'s history, Yala is one of the three [[Architects]] of the High [[Council]] and a legend among [[Consultants]] for stopping an [[Izyrian]] rebellion through infiltration.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c12">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 12</ref> After expressing happiness regarding [[Shera]]'s failure, Yala waited in a hidden bay with an ornate chest and attempted to take the Heart from [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c8">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref> Yala announced that [[Meia]] and [[Shera]] be detained for crimes against the [[Guild]], though Yala is actually [[Meia]]'s mother.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 24</ref> While Yala views the swearing-in of new [[Consultants]] as a religious duty, she once sat at the High [[Council]] conference table and spoke sourly, noting that her daughter had previously left her locked in a closet for an entire day.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c23">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“We have,” Yala said, firmly taking the reins of the conversation back from Kerian.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“My daughter left me locked in a closet for a full day. Where is she?”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Yala’s eyes narrowed, scrutinizing the cloud in the blade. Then she fell to one knee. “Guild Head,” she said.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Yala proved to me why they can’t trust the Regents.”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“Do you trust Yala and the High Council to make better decisions about the fate of the world than the Emperor?”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}
